items:
Check the fixed alarm at control 
 room by I&C engineer or by maintenance request from operation department.

By DCS system information I&C engineer can define the king of problem and 
 which cabinet and which FUM card has the problem

Each FUM card 
has an indication lamp OFF at normal operation.

If the indication lamp of FUM card flash light this means the problem in the 
 field then check the field devices (switches, transmitters, RTD, thermometers 
 ... etc)

If the indication lamp of FUM card fixed light this means the problem in FUM 
 module itself then change the FUM card

Power 
 Station | Technical 
 Procedure
Introduction
This document 
outlines the routine testing procedures I1 , which must performed on a daily bases as 
indicated by D1 in the title block.
These cabinets contains the following type of cards: FUM (Function 
Module)
FUM 210
FUM 230
FUM 232
FUM 280
FUM 511
FUM 531
The first draft initiated by eng: Gad El Mawla 
M. Abdel Rahman, 
reviewed by eng Mahmoud Ahmed Mahmoud, field tested by Hany Sobhie at 10 
October 2003, revised by EDEPC quality control 
eng: Abd El Monaem Al 
Emam, accepted by general director eng: Tarek Youssf, 
approved by eng: Mekhaael Gorge Habashi Sector inspector of Ayoun Moussa Power 
Station, and certified by eng. Aly Mostafa Allethy: EDEPCo. Head Sector of 
Inspection and quality control
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, 
the qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable safety category,
Wear your safety helmet, 
 safety shoes, eye glass, nose mouth "dust cover" .... etc
Wear Anti static hand probe to avoid electrical 
 choke
Unit must be shutdown.
Tools and Equipment
Digital multi-meter
Hand held radio wave for communication
Screw driver kit
Antistatic vacuum cleaner for dust cleaning
Work to be Carried Out
Each FUM card 
has an indication lamp OFF at normal operation.
Check the fixed alarm at control 
 room by I&C engineer or by maintenance request from operation department.
By DCS system information I&C engineer can define the king of problem and 
 which cabinet and which FUM card has the problem
Each FUM card 
has an indication lamp OFF at normal operation.
If the indication lamp of FUM card flash light this means the problem in the 
 field then check the field devices (switches, transmitters, RTD, thermometers 
 ... etc)
If the indication lamp of FUM card fixed light this means the problem in FUM 
 module itself then change the FUM card
